dct_description_sm: The objectives were to 1) Monitor seasonal trends in densities of indicator bacteria (total coliforms and E. coli) in Apex river during the annual flow period (June to October/November); 2) Determine how the densities and variability of indicator bacteria in the Apex are influenced by hydrologic and climatic factors (discharge, water temperature, pH, conductivity, etc.).
dct_subject_sm: Health sciences and contaminants -> Water quality
dct_title_s: Microbial indicator data for Apex River, Iqaluit, Nunavut
